criteria.a0_reproduction: >=2/3 A0 runs with primary >= 0.010 m, else 'baseline slip not reproduced; mechanism control not evaluated'
criteria.b_vs_aprime: all 3 B primary < min(APRIME) AND median drop >= 50% => representation has material effect; if APRIME already near zero, report no headroom, do not claim B superiority
criteria.invalid_b: penetration / missed contact / abnormal support => run invalid, not an improvement
criteria.failures: capture failures and early exits retained and judged per these rules; no auto re-runs, no selective repeats

discipline.per_run: independent sim reset; cleanup ONLY experiment-owned processes
discipline.records: runtime-loaded collision asset hash + params per run
discipline.freeze: harness/assets/order/criteria frozen before run 1; behavior changes after start invalidate the set
